notes.title: Version 1.14 is here!
notes.content:
Detective Hank received a small update today! This version 1.14 update includes:
[list]
[*] Small tests & updates to work on modern systems
[*] Changes to wrong text in dialogue
[/list]

There will also be a discount this weekend, so stay tuned!

tags.bug: [*] Changes to wrong text in dialogue

notes.title: Detective Hank v1.03 now available!
notes.content:
Detective Hank and the Golden Sneeze has been updated to version 1.03! The game is now usable on more platforms due to the new features of this release.

The new features of this update include:
[list]
[*]This game is now fully touch-screen compatible. If you want to play the game on a Windows tablet or other PC with touch screen, every button is now fully usable.
[*]We’ve added gamepad support! You can now enjoy Detective Hank from the comfort of your couch and solve the mystery on a big screen with your friends and family. 
[*]The gamepad support together with Linux support makes Detective Hank and the Golden Sneeze now fully playable on Steam OS.
[/list]

But we are not done yet! In a couple of weeks we hope to bring you the next big update. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Detective Hank updated to v1.02
notes.content:
Detective Hank and the Golden Sneeze has been updated to version 1.02! Apart from fixing a couple of glitches, we've also been listening to the feedback from the community and started implementing new features to the engine.

This update includes 2 new features:
[list]
[*]You can now jump to the next choice. If you feel the need to get straight to the next choice when, for example, you want to 100% the game, you can do so in the pause menu. Select the gutton to jump to the next choice and see the whole game fly by at super speed until the next choice arrives.
[*]The mouse scroll wheel now lets you read back previous text. If you missed a part of the story by an accidental click or jumping ahead with the new jump feature, you can now read back previous text by scrolling up with your mouse wheel. Incidentally, scrolling down brings you back to the end again.
[/list]

In the coming weeks we will be releasing more updates. Keep an eye on our site and Steam page!
